subject: Lean/Lake v4.30.0-rc2 trace rewrite field classification

classifications.basis: SavedTrace.replayIfUpToDate and replayOrFetchIfUpToDate compare this value with the current dependency/input hash.

SavedTrace.replayIfUpToDate replays the saved log after a successful freshness check.
replayOrFetchIfUpToDate uses synthetic together with log emptiness when selecting the fetch/replay action.
importConfigFile compares these fields when deciding whether the compiled configuration is current.
